records.text: A former schoolmate alleged that a male mentor bought new cars for Johnnie Moore’s family and that Ronald Godwin pressed Jerry Falwell Sr. to give Moore a Liberty University position.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep CMcktj3Egfo)

appearances.snippet: He had a male mentor. ... Who bought him and everyone in his family, allegedly, brand new cars. ... And this daddy mentor of his is the one that pushed for Jerry Falwell Sr. to give Johnnie a position with Liberty University. ... That man's name is Ron Godwin, Johnnie's mentor.

verification.notes: This is an anonymous composite allegation about private financial support and internal personnel pressure. No attributable, independently checkable corroboration was located.

records.text: Sun Myung Moon selected Ronald S. Godwin to run The Washington Times and declared him one of three disciples.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: picked Ron Godwin not only just to run the Washington Times for him, which I told you they purchased the Washington Times, but Moon also declared Ron Godwin to be one of his three disciples,

verification.notes: A primary Moon speech explicitly names Ronald Godwin among three collaborators likened to Jesus’s three disciples, and Godwin held senior roles in Moon-linked media. However, the stronger wording that Moon personally “selected” Godwin to run The Washington Times was not independently established from the consulted sources.

records.text: Ronald S. Godwin retired from Liberty University in October 2014, Johnnie Moore left at about the same time, and Moore was later repeatedly denied a return.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: when Ron Godwin retired from Liberty University in October of 2014, of course, his Johnnie boy left too ... all of a sudden he wanted back in at Liberty University and he was told no repeatedly.

verification.notes: Liberty confirms Godwin’s October 2014 retirement, and Moore’s biography supports his departure from Liberty around that period. The claim that Moore was later repeatedly denied a return rests on anonymous reporting in the episode and is not independently substantiated.
